A NOTE ON THE NUMBERS

Generosity, explained.

Each score averages five equally weighted estimates: permanence, usable capacity, feature access, commercial suitability, and ease of starting without a card. Each dimension is scored from 0 to 4, then scaled to 100.

These are draft editorial scores from the initial catalog, not verified measurements or product-quality ratings. Scores are most useful within a category. Equal scores share a rank. Self-hosted tools require your own hosting; usage-priced services charge transaction or usage fees. Trial-only entries are omitted.

Catalog compiled September 15, 2026 · Official sources linked for every entry
